name: sutando
description: Sutando — a personal AI agent. Voice interface backed by Claude Code.

scripts.test:py: for f in tests/*.test.py; do echo "--- $f ---" && python3 "$f" || exit 1; done
scripts.postinstall: patch-package && node -e "const {chmodSync,existsSync}=require('fs'); for (const arch of ['darwin-arm64','darwin-x64','linux-x64','linux-arm64']) { const p='node_modules/node-pty/prebuilds/'+arch+'/spawn-helper'; if (existsSync(p)) { try { chmodSync(p, 0o755) } catch (_) {} } }"
